block.title: The Devcon Music Committee presents: the Ethereum Foundation
block.line: Two hours of the EF's own musicians on the floor — the people who write the protocol, playing the songs. They know the volume, so the afternoon is theirs.

seats.name: Tomo Saito
seats.role: Ethereum Foundation · on the Devcon committee
seats.note: speaks Nov 6, 12:00 · Jasmine Stage 4, then holds the floor at 2

ideas.d: Each EF musician plays 15 minutes, then hands the aux to someone from the crowd — a colleague, a stranger, a speaker who just came off stage.
Before each set: one minute on the song they'd play if Ethereum had a soundtrack. The room listens, then joins in.
The last 15 minutes lean into the Devcon team's 4pm closing party — the EF hands the floor to DJ Amogh together, with a toast.
It's a circle, not a stage: the front row is the floor, and the last chair is always empty on purpose.
